audit.reason: Compact entrance teaches a statue bypass and has only 2 guards, no camera, 6.0-tile authored escape. Preserve its read-before-crossing skeleton; physical Tier 1 acceptance remains required.
232-floor-tile rotunda and west-in/east-out loggia offer a real two-sided route choice; combine its central exhibit identity with the private salon rather than retain both missions.
Bent 18×14 archive is distinct, but safe/risk lengths 22.8/22.2 almost coincide and only the spawn is authored safe. Replace precision aisle dependency with wide shelf-end observation pockets.
Keep office/hub/gate/inspection-bay story; 3 guards in 106 floor tiles need spatially separated crossings for an easy chapter.
Keep the east jewel chamber and separate north service return as finale material; do not carry over 4-guard/1-camera coverage or 29.1-tile escape wholesale.
Paired restoration tables and specimen store enrich archive/conservation fantasy; remove this 360-floor-tile separate mission and its 55.9-tile alternate escape.
Private foyer, west portrait rooms and south salon supply an intimate collection wing to the rotunda; its separate 3-guard bridge challenge is redundant for Tier 1.

Remove the old Security Core mission and its compound pressure. Its cross-hub visual landmark may inform Security Wing only; 5 guards/2 cameras, 46.1-tile safe approach and 46.5-tile escape contradict easy museum. Real user reported excessive objective pressure and hitching.
Use stepped sculpture promenade and north portrait balcony as finale landmarks; do not retain an additional 55.9-tile safe approach with 4 guards.
Keep sanctuary spectacle and a separate cloister escape; replace 686 floor tiles, 6 guards/2 cameras and exit-cluster pressure with the same easy encounter budget as the chapter.
Compact clean arrival/sculpture-court/art-wall reveal supplies the introduction to the combined sculpture mission; 2-guard/0-camera baseline is useful.

Portrait spine, paired opaque art screens, east artwork and short northwest escape form a distinct long-LOS mission. Preserve corrected portrait identity; roaming overlap needs Tier 2 acceptance, not automatic certification.
Carving bays/commission court/installation annex distinguish sculpture from portrait. Compress the 52.1-tile safe approach and merge with 02-01 rather than add another 4-guard mission.
Staggered movable-screen wing with west collection and southeast court is useful; 38.9/60.3-tile escape and multiple junctions need compact, readable Easy+ circulation.
Private reception/portrait salon/service return repeats the private-collection role already supplied by portrait and finale; no unique glass or movable-wall mechanic to preserve as a sixth mission.

Preserve glazed installation court and separate east sculpture escape. 521 floor tiles, 5 guards/1 camera and 34.4/49.4-tile escapes exceed a concise Easy+ glass lesson; explicitly preserve BLOCK bodies/PASS LOS.
Curator workroom and north public return add a clear service choice to Modern Wing; avoid importing its additional 5-guard/1-camera crossing network.
Paired monumental atrium supplies finale approach and reveal, not a separate 43.0-tile guarded return.
Southern private masterpiece and northeast portrait balcony repeat collection/portrait roles; 110.1-tile authored safe approach and 78.7-tile escape inflate travel without a necessary new mechanism.

Keep masterpiece chamber, opaque first-break screen and delayed alarm; replace 750 floor tiles and 7 guards/2 cameras with compact Easy+ finale. Human Tilt CLEAR demonstrates playability, not equal chapter difficulty.
Public/teller/staff verification/dispatch sequence is already bank-specific. Add Teller Hall route choice without simply stacking its security population.
Long teller spine, west staff bypass and U-return provide two meaningful access modes to the same financial target; retain counter line as cover, not generic walls.
Six-room staggered office network offers room transitions; combine with Records audit target, avoiding 42.2-tile traversal solely to increase duration.
Narrow intake/ledger spine/audit alcove/upper verification return provides the actual restricted-records heist in the combined office mission.
Deposit-wall landmark, two access lanes and independent service return distinguish it from checkpoints/vault; 4 guards/1 camera are evidence only, not a fixed numeric difficulty requirement.
Keep staffed main gate and genuine west bypass; restructure excessive 48.0-tile safe detour into readable sequential credential/command crossings.
Cash-processing tables and carts are operational bank escape material. Their low tables do not block LOS; include as the vault return, not a detached repetitive cash-floor mission.
Monitoring command objective plus independent east audit exit make Checkpoint a complete heist. Do not append its entire 5-guard/2-camera map to 03-06.
Visible vault door and protected observation antechamber supply the final pre-vault read, rather than another stand-alone vaultGem pickup.

Keep PUBLIC→STAFF→SECURITY→VAULT progression and distinct east cash/records escape as the medium benchmark. User said manageable; 60.1-tile main/106.2-tile safe/56.8-tile escape are not mandatory retention targets or evidence of Tier 3 fairness.

missions.title: Entrance Hall
missions.fantasy: Read the first guard, circle a grand statue, take the display diamond and leave confidently.
missions.architecture: Compact bent lobby / statue exhibition / recessed case room / east side door.
missions.mainRoute: Lobby → statue shoulder → single exhibition crossing → case.
missions.safeRoute: North viewing recess with a protected wait before the case.
missions.riskRoute: Direct south-side statue crossing while the guard faces away.
missions.objective: Diamond on a lit recessed display with one clear observation position.
missions.exit: East side door, visible after pickup; first opaque break at the case-room return corner.
missions.securityIdentity: One crossing at a time; no CCTV; no simultaneous objective/exit pressure.

missions.title: Rotunda Collection
missions.fantasy: Choose a quiet portrait loggia or cross the central rotunda to reach a private collection.
missions.architecture: West vestibule / round-looking two-sided exhibit island / north salon / east loggia.
missions.mainRoute: Vestibule → exhibit shoulder → north salon → east loggia escape.
missions.safeRoute: Outer portrait arc with protected sightline reads at both ends.
missions.riskRoute: Short central rotunda crossing, visible guard turn providing a clear window.
missions.objective: Artifact in the north salon beside an opaque statue shoulder.
missions.exit: Independent east loggia; one return corner gives immediate post-theft separation.
missions.securityIdentity: Patrol watches the central floor; collection watch is sequential, never a double pickup cone.

missions.title: Archive & Conservation
missions.fantasy: Slip through readable shelf ends and restoration benches to recover a catalogued artifact.
missions.architecture: Bent staff entry / two broad shelf bays / conservation workroom / east staff return.
missions.mainRoute: Staff elbow → shelf-end cover → restoration bay → restricted cabinet.
missions.safeRoute: Connected outer shelf shoulders with room to correct Tilt overshoot.
missions.riskRoute: Central shelf aisle shortcut with one timed perpendicular sightline.
missions.objective: Artifact in a conservation specimen cabinet, not an isolated corridor end.
missions.exit: East staff door via a short storage elbow; cabinet-side opaque shelf is first break.
missions.securityIdentity: Low-speed observation lesson through spatial windows, not narrower gaps; no CCTV.

missions.title: Restricted Wing
missions.fantasy: Read a small security office and take a restricted museum record through a quiet outbound bay.
missions.architecture: Office / control hub / restricted case / east inspection bay / north staff door.
missions.mainRoute: Office → hub planning pocket → one guarded access → restricted case.
missions.safeRoute: Outer office-to-inspection circuit with one protected turn before pickup.
missions.riskRoute: Short hub crossing avoids the inspection detour but exposes the player briefly.
missions.objective: Restricted archive case adjacent to the control-room landmark and an opaque shoulder.
missions.exit: North staff door through inspection return; no stationary exit cluster.
missions.securityIdentity: At most one active sightline at the objective; optional single CCTV only on approach, spatially separated from pickup.

missions.title: Grand Museum Heist
missions.fantasy: Steal the museum centerpiece, then disappear into its service cloister.
missions.architecture: Compact arrival gallery / sculpture promenade / sanctuary / separate cloister return.
missions.mainRoute: Arrival → sculpture landmark → sanctuary approach → centerpiece.
missions.safeRoute: Outer viewing shoulder and sanctuary alcove with clear stop-and-go opportunities.
missions.riskRoute: Direct exhibition axis offers a shorter, briefly exposed approach.
missions.objective: Master diamond in a warm-lit sanctuary with a nearby genuine opaque escape shoulder.
missions.exit: West service door after the cloister; no grouped guard posts near the door.
missions.securityIdentity: Same easy pressure as 01-01–04; grander landmark/space, not additional simultaneous watchers.

missions.title: Sculpture Court
missions.fantasy: Cross an open modern gallery using commissioned sculptures as timing landmarks.
missions.architecture: Clean arrival / two-sided sculpture island / north commission recess / east installation annex.
missions.mainRoute: Arrival → central sculpture shoulder → north commissioned work → east annex.
missions.safeRoute: Outer island viewing edge with two explicit protected stops.
missions.riskRoute: Direct open-floor crossing when the patrol has passed.
missions.objective: Featured commissioned artwork integrated with the sculpture display.
missions.exit: East annex via an opaque art-screen corner immediately after the target.
missions.securityIdentity: Longer crossing than Museum, but a single interpretable patrol lane; no camera overlap at pickup.

missions.title: Portrait Hall
missions.fantasy: Read a long portrait sightline and use paired art screens to reach a featured painting.
missions.architecture: Reception / long portrait spine / opaque screen shoulders / east portrait recess / northwest return.
missions.mainRoute: Reception → spine screen → portrait recess → upper collection return.
missions.safeRoute: Outer portrait wall and screen-back viewing shoulders.
missions.riskRoute: Direct spine crossing trades time for greater exposure.
missions.objective: Vertical portrait grouping with featured painting in the eastern recess.
missions.exit: Northwest public door via a short upper-wall return and first opaque screen break.
missions.securityIdentity: Long LOS/turn timing, not extra guard count; wandering watcher must not seal the safe option.

missions.title: Modern Wing
missions.fantasy: Pick a public art-screen route or a curator service route through a staggered wing.
missions.architecture: North arrival / movable-screen exhibition / west curator recess / south installation / southeast court.
missions.mainRoute: Arrival → screen junction → west collection → installation return.
missions.safeRoute: Curator workroom shoulders behind opaque exhibition screens.
missions.riskRoute: Cross the open movable-screen axis in one observed timing window.
missions.objective: Modern artwork in the curator-side collection, anchored to a named screen ensemble.
missions.exit: Southeast court on a readable service return with a nearby opaque objective-side screen.
missions.securityIdentity: Two successive open-space reads; avoid simultaneous junction cones and long backtracking.

missions.title: Glass Gallery
missions.fantasy: See the treasure through glass and deliberately choose a physical route around it.
missions.architecture: West studies / glazed central installation / north study / independent east sculpture gallery.
missions.mainRoute: Approach → glass-side viewing shoulder → north study → east art-cell return.
missions.safeRoute: Opaque art-screen perimeter; glass itself is never described as concealment.
missions.riskRoute: Short glazed-court crossing when the distant guard is facing away.
missions.objective: Featured study visible through glazing, with an accessible opaque return shoulder.
missions.exit: East sculpture door after art cells interrupt pursuit.
missions.securityIdentity: Glass BLOCK movement/PASS LOS; limited sweep watches one exposed crossing, not objective plus escape simultaneously.

missions.title: Masterpiece Chamber
missions.fantasy: Take a major masterpiece and escape through an alternate public collection.
missions.architecture: Atrium introduction / masterpiece recess / opaque first-break screen / portrait inspection / separate exit collection.
missions.mainRoute: Atrium shoulder → masterpiece reveal → pickup → screened return.
missions.safeRoute: Outer installation arc with a protected wait before the masterpiece.
missions.riskRoute: Open atrium axis is shorter and has one clear observation window.
missions.objective: Masterpiece in a lit chamber; delayed alarm retained, no instant hidden-player knowledge.
missions.exit: Separate west collection door with an escape pocket before its final observed crossing.
missions.securityIdentity: Same Easy+ simultaneous-pressure ceiling as the other Gallery missions; no 7-guard finale escalation.

missions.title: Teller Access
missions.fantasy: Move from the public queue through staffed access to a teller-held valuable.
missions.architecture: Public lobby / teller spine / west staff bypass / verification elbow / dispatch bay.
missions.mainRoute: Public planning pocket → teller access crossing → staff verification → teller target.
missions.safeRoute: West staff-office bypass behind counters, then one observed verification gate.
missions.riskRoute: Direct teller-spine crossing is shorter but watched from the public side.
missions.objective: Teller-held gem with counter landmark and staff threshold beyond it.
missions.exit: Independent dispatch door through the verification elbow; counter return offers first break.
missions.securityIdentity: Distinct public/staff security roles and a limited CCTV crossing, separated in time; medium budget shared across Bank.

missions.title: Staff Records
missions.fantasy: Navigate real staff rooms to steal an audited record without retracing the intake.
missions.architecture: Staggered offices / ledger spine / secure audit alcove / upper verification return.
missions.mainRoute: Staff intake → office corner → records crossing → audit alcove.
missions.safeRoute: Filing-cabinet edge and an alternative office sequence with protected door reads.
missions.riskRoute: Shared records-bank crossing cuts a room but exposes the player.
missions.objective: Sealed valuable in the audit alcove with a visible record-bank landmark.
missions.exit: Upper verification dispatch; opaque cabinet corner immediately separates the pickup from search.
missions.securityIdentity: Door timing and room/corridor roles; CCTV belongs to one records crossing, not every doorway.

missions.title: Deposit Boxes
missions.fantasy: Choose a monitored deposit lane or service approach to a bank deposit target.
missions.architecture: Public deposit reception / twin access lanes / deposit-wall landmark / security seam / service return.
missions.mainRoute: Reception → selected lane → restricted box wall → service return.
missions.safeRoute: Staff-office shoulder gives a longer but genuinely less exposed approach.
missions.riskRoute: Deposit-front lane offers a brief direct crossing during a sweep pause.
missions.objective: Valuable within the deposit-wall collection, accompanied by a staffed security seam.
missions.exit: Separate service door after a protected deposit-bank break and an observed dispatch crossing.
missions.securityIdentity: One CCTV with staffed roles, spatially separate watches; low desks/cash carts are not full LOS cover.

missions.title: Checkpoint Command
missions.fantasy: Cross credential security or an analyst bypass to steal the monitoring command asset.
missions.architecture: Public read bay / staffed gate / west analyst bypass / controlled junction / command room / east audit exit.
missions.mainRoute: Planning bay → credential gate → controlled junction → monitoring command.
missions.safeRoute: West analyst circuit through protected room corners; comparable task count, reduced exposure.
missions.riskRoute: Short gate-and-junction route requires observing two sequential security phases.
missions.objective: Command asset among monitoring desks and record cabinets inside a restricted room.
missions.exit: Independent east audit door after an opaque command-room return corner.
missions.securityIdentity: CCTV plus guard timing with separated checkpoints; never make both options permanently covered.

missions.title: Main Vault
missions.fantasy: Penetrate the actual bank vault and escape through cash operations and records dispatch.
missions.architecture: Staff access / credential checkpoint / inner security / visible antechamber / Main Vault / cash-processing return / records evacuation.
missions.mainRoute: Staff approach → checkpoint → antechamber read → vault pickup → cash circuit.
missions.safeRoute: Protected records shoulders and a side antechamber viewing route.
missions.riskRoute: Direct security crossings shorten the approach, never remove all waiting positions.
missions.objective: Delayed-alarm vault gem within the actual reinforced Main Vault landmark.
missions.exit: Lateral records evacuation separate from staff entry; vault-side opaque break before cash-floor exposure.
missions.securityIdentity: Retain old 03-10 manageable-feel benchmark; cash tables PASS LOS, opaque cabinets establish genuine cover. Do not raise speed or detection timing for finale.
